cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(DebuggerPhase3BFixture LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(GUIDEXOS_SERVER_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "guideXOS Server checkout")
if(NOT GUIDEXOS_SERVER_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pass -DGUIDEXOS_SERVER_ROOT=<server-checkout>")
endif()
add_executable(debugger-phase3b.elf src/main.cpp src/freestanding_memory.cpp)
target_include_directories(debugger-phase3b.elf PRIVATE "${GUIDEXOS_SERVER_ROOT}/sdk/include")
target_compile_options(debugger-phase3b.elf PRIVATE --target=x86_64-unknown-elf -ffreestanding -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -fno-stack-protector -fno-unwind-tables -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables)
target_link_options(debugger-phase3b.elf PRIVATE --target=x86_64-unknown-elf -nostdlib -static -fuse-ld=lld -Wl,-e,gx_main)
set_target_properties(debugger-phase3b.elf PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME debugger-phase3b SUFFIX ".elf")
